propDocs.Menu.loop: Wraps arrow-key navigation at the ends of a menu.
propDocs.Menu.dismissible: Allows Escape and outside interactions to dismiss the menu.
propDocs.Menu.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
propDocs.Menu.modal: Pointer mode consumes the outside press; true also traps focus and locks scroll; false allows outside interaction.
propDocs.MenuTrigger.disabled: Prevents the trigger from opening the menu.
propDocs.MenuTrigger.focusableWhenDisabled: Keeps a disabled trigger focusable with aria-disabled.
propDocs.MenuContent.align: Start, center or end alignment along that side.
propDocs.MenuContent.sideOffset: Gap from the trigger, in pixels.
propDocs.MenuItem.closeOnSelect: Closes the menu after a plain action. Checkboxes retain their original stay-open behaviour.
propDocs.MenuItem.destructive: Marks a dangerous action with destructive styling.
